findings.title: Canonical Redirect Loop (Apex vs WWW)
findings.description: https://iptvsmartproviders.com redirects via 308 Permanent Redirect to https://iptvsmartproviders.com. However, the HTML canonical tag on www points back to apex, creating an indexing contradiction.
findings.recommendation: Update siteConfig.url, metadataBase, and sitemap baseUrl to 'https://www.iptvsmartproviders.com' to match the live canonical domain.

findings.title: Sitemap URLs Contain Redirected Endpoints
findings.description: All URLs listed in sitemap.xml point to https://iptvsmartproviders.com. Search engines encounter a 308 redirect on every sitemap crawl.
findings.recommendation: Change baseUrl in app/sitemap.ts and app/robots.ts to use the canonical www host.
